2026-07-07 Korea

Korea Day 4

Breakfast

I actually ordered a chicken sandwich but the waiter brought me a different dish. Totally my bad for not using a translator app, but it was still good!
This açaí drink was amazing. I might have it every day!

Posters

Wish I had more time today for poster sessions. Had some good conversations about related research but had to be at our sponsor booth for a while.

Lunch

Went for lunch with a few colleagues. The line for the restaurant was long, we probably waited 30 minutes. Food was good, but not sure if it was worth the wait, lol.

Sponsor Booths

TD is sponsoring ICML this year, so we had a booth. I spent a lot of time there talking to people about our research, career opportunities, and our company. I even got the chance to talk to people in my field I didn't get to talk to in the poster sessions which was great.

Our booth. They missed a few of us in this pic :(, but it's the best photo of hte booth I have
As usual, most of the booths were from hedge funds. Tons of swag and cool puzzles
I had to do the chess puzzle rush. I'll take 10th place with this audience, but I'll try again tomorrow

Dinner

Had a nice dinner at a Korean BBQ place with everyone who came from TD. I thought the tradition at Korean BBQ was to cook the meat yourself, but this place had a people that cooked it for us. Apparently that's the true fancy way to do it. The food was absolutely amazing, and so were the conversations (and the soju, lol).
